title: When the Oath Sings Again
author: Astrid Underhill
blurb: Sebastian Oyelaran, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
